title: Embedding a finite machine as an oracle machine
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic Turing machine over a symbol alphabet. Its associated finite oracle Turing machine has the same number of ordinary work tapes, state set enlarged by three additional states, and underlying oracle machine obtained from $M$ by the standard conversion from a deterministic machine to an oracle machine.
